title: Mate calculus for a pasted adjunction
statement:
Let $p$ and $\ell$ be distinct primes, let $q$ be a power of $p$, and put $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, let $n\ge1$ be an integer, put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, and choose $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$. Fix a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] with these parameters. Let $X,Y,Z$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be composable separated finite-type morphisms, with the adjunctions $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$, $Rg_!\dashv Rg^!$ and
$R(gf)_!\dashv R(gf)^!$ on the finite-Tor categories supplied by axiom (A1)
of [def-sf-datum] (i.e. the ambient right adjoints of
[def-weil-exceptional-adjoint-admissibility] restricted along its
preservation clause (3)). Then the mate of the composition isomorphism
$R(gf)_!\cong Rg_!Rf_!$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition] under these adjunctions is the isomorphism $(gf)^!\cong f^!g^!$, and the
units and counits of the composite adjunctions are the pasted ones.
([fix-prop-adjunctions], item (3).)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: write a_f, a_g, a_h for the three given adjunctions and e : R(gf)_! ≅ Rg_! Rf_!. Then (CategoryTheory.conjugateIsoEquiv (a_f.comp a_g) a_h e).symm is the required R(gf)^! ≅ Rf^! Rg^! (Mates.lean:425-435). The pasted unit and counit are exactly CategoryTheory.Adjunction.comp_unit_app (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Basic.lean:575-577) and comp_counit_app (Basic.lean:580-582), for the composite constructed by Adjunction.comp (Basic.lean:567-573). Compatibility with the original adjunction, one lemma per clause, is CategoryTheory.unit_conjugateEquiv (Mates.lean:300-309) and CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv_counit (Mates.lean:285-288), applied to e.hom. All categories and adjunctions are parameters; there is no restriction to finite coefficients and no extra geometric hypothesis.
